'''''Mercenaries' Despair''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The master painting was part of a two-painting set which attempted to capture the despair and internal struggle in the [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] throughout the galaxy. This particular painting depicted a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] mercenary full of despair.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Mercenaries' Despair'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
